mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT contact.*, customer.owner_id AS scope_owner_id, customer.dept_id AS scope_dept_id FROM crm_contact contact JOIN crm_customer customer ON customer.customer_id = contact.customer_id AND customer.tenant_id = contact.tenant_id WHERE contact.deleted = 0 AND customer.deleted = 0 AND contact.status = 'ACTIVE' ) scoped
